title: Waivers and Corrections Left Out of a Parking Catch-Up: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Truth Table
content:
**Rule.** The parking catch-up amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization leaves out charges the tenant was excused from: **the posted late fee and the returned-payment fee** where the latest courtesy late-fee waiver on the parking agreement was credited against a late fee and the latest billing-error correction against a returned-payment fee; **the posted late fee alone** where only such a waiver is on record; **the returned-payment fee alone** where only such a correction is on record; and **nothing** otherwise. What is left out is subtracted.

**Records.** On the parking ledger: the courtesy late-fee waiver credit with the latest entry date and the fee entry it references (its fee type and amount); the billing-error correction credit with the latest entry date and the fee entry it references (its fee type). The posted late fee is the amount of the late fee entry the waiver references. The returned-payment fee is the parking class figure: $30.00, except $35.00 on Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage.

| Latest courtesy waiver references a late fee | Latest billing-error correction references a returned-payment fee | Left out |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Posted late fee plus returned-payment fee |
| Yes | No (or no correction) | Posted late fee |
| No (or no waiver) | Yes | Returned-payment fee |
| No (or no waiver) | No (or no correction) | Nothing |

**Hypothetical, Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft):** waiver against a late fee posted at $35.00 and correction against a returned-payment fee: $65.00 left out. Waiver only: $35.00. Correction only: $30.00. The latest correction references a vehicle swap fee and no waiver is on record: nothing.
